confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on user-submitted Numbeo Marmaris figures and Turkish resort price listings, with TRY converted at an assumed 48 to 50 TRY per USD and a judgment-based July peak uplift. Cocktail and wine rely on bar and wine listings and were sense-checked against the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no accommodation searches or live listings, so they are the weakest. FX is the latest RBA daily rate I could verify (2026-03-20), about eight months before the generation date, so it may be stale and should be refreshed before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No named comparable city was used. Basis is Marmaris-specific food and drink listings, plus a holistic July peak-season resort view for accommodation. Region set to Europe as a Mediterranean/Aegean resort, although Turkey is transcontinental and could also be classed as Middle East.
